summary: Spectrum Brands Holdings filed an 8-K announcing a strategic investment in its Home and Personal Care business by Oaktree Capital Management for $127 million cash: $67 million in convertible preferred equity (8% compounding quarterly) and $60 million in a first-lien term loan (SOFR+5.50% or base+4.50%). The structure is a minority equity and debt investment, not a full acquisition. The board approved; terms include no capital call obligations and delinking of HPC from parent collateral. Oaktree will own ~27% pro forma. Expected close May 11, 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. Watch closing conditions and potential future separation of HPC.
